reason: H0 unconditionally calls spng_set_crc_action(ctx, SPNG_CRC_USE, SPNG_CRC_USE), so it bypasses S1's default ancillary SPNG_CRC_DISCARD behavior. Consequently it cannot exercise the new rollback calls that undo appended text_list or splt_list entries when an ancillary chunk is discarded, leaving fuzz-worthy allocation, counter, and parser-state transitions uncovered.
evidence: spng_ctx_new2 now initializes crc_action_critical to SPNG_CRC_ERROR and crc_action_ancillary to SPNG_CRC_DISCARD.
H0 overrides both settings with SPNG_CRC_USE before decoding.
The SPNG_CRC_USE comment says "Ignore and don't calculate checksum", preventing CRC-driven discard.
read_non_idat_chunks assigns undo = text_undo and undo = splt_undo, then invokes undo(ctx) when discard is observed.
text_undo and splt_undo free entry-owned allocations, clear pointers, and decrement ctx->n_text or ctx->n_splt.
recommended_action: Add harness modes that preserve the spng_ctx_new2 defaults and explicitly select ancillary SPNG_CRC_DISCARD; fuzz text and sPLT ancillary chunks with invalid CRCs, including repeated valid/discarded chunks and continued parsing afterward, then exercise spng_get_text, spng_get_splt, decoding, and context cleanup.
